decision: A1 flat-authorization: operator chose to DOCUMENT single-operator posture rather than change RBAC. Any Pocket ID user admitted by the IdP is a full operator by design; multi-user privilege separation deferred behind a future fail-closed config.
rationale: Restricting the baseline `user` role would disable the terminal (core workbench feature) for non-admins. Single-operator is the intended install posture.

decision: Implement A2-A10 and R1-R6 per prioritized fix plan; A1 doc-only. Producer opus, validator fresh-context agent.

decision: Validation caught two live A2 bypasses that were fixed before completion: (1) advisor found fetch() default redirect-follow lets a public host 302->169.254.169.254 -> added redirect:'error' to fetchToolsViaHttp; (2) fresh-context opus validator PROVED via execution that IPv4-mapped IPv6 (::ffff:a9fe:a9fe, the hex form new URL() emits) bypassed the dotted-only regex, plus fe8x link-local gap -> rewrote isPrivateIPv6 as a raw-byte parser. Also sealed R2 TRUNCATE. All re-verified with tests + real Postgres.
rationale: Separate-model validation is mandatory per DoD; both issues were real and reachable.
